$comment: Small-game budgets (decision 0137). size: the game package of each example (mtek build --release --itch), the folder and the zip, in bytes; checked in CI by scripts/game-budgets.mjs size, which also fails when an example directory has no entry here. frame: p95 frame time of scripts/record-frame-evidence.mjs on a real GPU; checked by scripts/game-budgets.mjs frames, never on a software adapter. Raise a budget only in a reviewed commit that says why. Size budgets were re-baselined on 2026-10-23 (Windows, main d28886b8 plus the green-main fixes) as the measured size plus 10 %, rounded up to 10 kB: the runtime had grown about 13 % since 2026-10-21 and pulse-cube and modular-scene were over budget. The four game examples (small-game, sprite-pop, lane-runner, stage-show) were added then.
